mission_10: Congratulations! You've built a comprehensive data cleaning pipeline that handles duplicates, text normalization, type conversion, missing values, currency formatting, and date standardization. This end-to-end pipeline demonstrates how individual cleaning techniques combine into a production-ready workflow. The key lessons are: order matters in pipelines, each step should be idempotent, and validation checks should be included at each stage. You now have the skills to tackle real-world messy datasets with confidence.
